annotations.title: Daily guides for an app's website

description: Daily guides for one app's website: whether they're on and what's missing to turn them on (a verified website in a connected Search Console, and a plan that includes them), and its guides, newest first. Each guide answers one Google search that shows the site but is rarely clicked: the search and its numbers, the need behind it, the title, address slug, meta description, the guide in Markdown with its two calls to action, the sentences to add on the site's own pages to link to it, and every claim the check read with what backs it (status held: something couldn't be backed; fix it before publishing). agent_spec is the whole job for a coding agent: where the page goes, its head tags and structured data, the links to add, the checks. Published guides carry their Google clicks and impressions since. Apptiller never publishes them.
